title: Recipe Steps & Ingredients
description: Build a structured recipe page using ordered and unordered lists with a definition list for key terms.
problemStatement:
You're writing a recipe page for a smoothie. Create a well‑structured HTML document (just the body content) with:

- A main heading "Berry Blast Smoothie".
- An **unordered list** of ingredients (at least 4 items).
- An **ordered list** of preparation steps (at least 3 steps).
- A **description list** that defines two cooking terms you used (e.g., "Blend" and "Garnish").

Make sure all list types are used correctly and the code is properly nested.
hints: Remember to put the <ul> and <ol> as siblings, not nested inside each other.
The <dl>, <dt>, <dd> can go after the lists; they're separate sections.
Use meaningful content; the exact text is up to you, but follow the structure.
expectedOutput: A page body with one h1, one ul (ingredients), one ol (steps), and one dl (definitions). Lists must be valid HTML.
solutionCode:
Berry Blast Smoothie

Ingredients

  • 1 cup frozen mixed berries
  • 1 banana
  • 1/2 cup yogurt
  • 1/4 cup orange juice
  • 1 tablespoon honey

Instructions

  1. Add all ingredients to the blender.
  2. Blend on high until smooth.
  3. Pour into a glass and garnish with a mint leaf.

Glossary

Blend
To mix thoroughly using a blender until a uniform consistency is achieved.
Garnish
To add a decorative and flavourful item on top of the finished dish.
